input.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE ??.UNIFIED_CUSTOMER_RECORD AS
with unified_cust AS(
select 
SFDC.ID as IDEA_ID,
  SFDC.FIRSTNAME as FIRST_NAME,
  SFDC.LASTNAME as LAST_NAME,
  SFDC.PHONE as PHONE_NUMBER,
  SFDC.EMAIL as EMAIL,
  SFDC.MAILINGSTATE as STATE_PROVIDENCE,
  SFDC.MAILINGCOUNTRY as COUNTRY,
  LOY.LOYALTY_TIER as LOYALTY_TIER,
  SFDC.CLV__C as CLV,
  LOY.CSTAT AS CSTAT,
  CASE
  	WHEN clv IS NULL THEN 0 
 	WHEN clv BETWEEN 0 AND ?? THEN 1
 	WHEN clv BETWEEN 10000 AND 19999 THEN 2
 	WHEN clv BETWEEN ?? AND 29999 THEN 3
 	WHEN clv BETWEEN 30000 AND 49999 THEN 4
 	WHEN clv >= 50000 THEN 5
  END AS expected_customer_tier,
  CASE
  	WHEN loy.LOYALTY_TIER = 'Gold' THEN 3
  	WHEN loy.LOYALTY_TIER = '??' THEN 2
  	WHEN loy.LOYALTY_TIER = 'Silver' THEN 1
  	ELSE 0
  END AS customer_tier_modifier
FROM ??.SALESFORCE_CONTACT SFDC
JOIN ??.LOYALTY_INFO LOY
ON LOY.EMAIL = SFDC.EMAIL
)
SELECT DISTINCT
IDEA_ID
,FIRST_NAME
,LAST_NAME
,PHONE_NUMBER
,EMAIL
,STATE_PROVIDENCE
,COUNTRY
,CASE 
	WHEN expected_customer_tier + customer_tier_modifier > 5 THEN 5
	ELSE expected_customer_tier + customer_tier_modifier
END AS CUSTOMER_TIER
,CSTAT
,LOYALTY_TIER
,CLV
,'0' as AOV
,'0' as RFM
FROM unified_cust;
